articles.title: Why Your Zip Code Is Uninsurable
articles.summary: One insurance company had zero losses in the 2025 LA fires. Meanwhile, State Farm, Allstate, and Farmers all pulled back coverage across the US. So what does this company know that 100-year-old insurers don't?*Want to know the other industries primed for disruption? We found them:* https://clickhubspot.com/a8ozTraditional home insurance prices risk by zip code — a system built for mail delivery, not wildfire prediction. That's why entire neighborhoods get flagged "uninsurable" even when some houses on the block would clearly survive a fire.
